Arabeskas Anon Cannon is a 35-year-old secretary at a law firm who enjoys vandalising bus stops, baking and eating out. She is curious and strong willed, but can also be very headstrong and a bit impulsive.

She's sly and hardy. But this is all just a facade, a mechanism to deal with her horrifying past.

She was born and grew up in a loving family in a large community, she lived comfortably until she was about 13 years old, but at that point things took a turn for the worst.

She lost her parents in a rebellion and was abandoned by all. While persued by a criminal gang she had to survive in a wicked world. But with her courage and diligence, she managed to face all obstacles and overcome all odds. This has turned her into the woman she is today.

Powerless to change the past, she now works alone with the dream of exploring the deepest parts of space. By doing so, she hopes to forget about the past and finally find pleasureful life she has never had.
